01

The project

Legacy Garage 26 brings together classic cars, hands-on engineering, and storytelling. It is a chance to understand how a machine works by spending time with the real thing.

02

More than the car

The project connects people across generations and cultures. Restoration progress, interviews, and Corvair history are all part of the story.

03

What I’m exploring

  • Mechanical design and restoration
  • Documenting the process through photos and media
  • Organizing people and building a project identity
  • Turning real parts into CAD and 3D models
THE THREAD CONNECTING IT ALL

A car is a machine, a piece of history, and a reason for people to come together.
